title: El modelo de Emilie: la sección
description: docs/quests/emilie.md § The section, as built. The side view of the ground under Poble Sec: landing in El suelo, a stake measured, the well at the far end without power, a patrol beaten and its lamp lit, the lift going down, Las gravas and Bajo la ciudad crossed the other way, and El fondo with El que no converge. Run it with --gpu.

steps.eval: navigator.getGamepads = () => []; window.g = window.gerard.game; window.at = x => g.modelo.walk(x);
for (const p of Object.values(g.modelo.run.patrols)) p.rest = 999; g.modelo.run.patrols['celdas-1'].x = 12;

steps.caption: Landing in El suelo: all of it a guess, the mesh in phosphor green, a patrol of celdas secas ahead; nowhere to hide
One of Emilie's stakes on the way: «Medir»
Measured: the ground round it is real, and the boss will have a mark of Error less. No longer a safe place
The well at the far end: headframe, pulley, the shaft down through the clay, the cage at the bottom. Its panel's two lamps are off: «Sin corriente»
Up close: the cage, the cable, and the panel with a lamp for each patrol of the zone

steps.eval: (() => { const r = g.modelo.run; delete r.patrols['celdas-2']; if (!r.beaten.includes('celdas-2')) r.beaten.push('celdas-2'); })()

steps.caption: A patrol beaten: one lamp lit, and the cage and the shaft light up
Going down: the cage stays with them while the section rises past
Las gravas: they come out under the well they came down; the next one is at the other end

steps.eval: (() => { const r = g.modelo.run; delete r.patrols['oscilacion-1']; if (!r.beaten.includes('oscilacion-1')) r.beaten.push('oscilacion-1'); })()

steps.caption: The well of Las gravas, at the left end, lit by an Oscilación beaten
Bajo la ciudad: the tunnels the model was told about, and El Átomo

steps.eval: (() => { const p = g.modelo.run.patrols['atomo-1']; const f = g.modelo.figures.get('atomo-1'); const at = f.getPosition(); g.frame({ x: at.x, y: at.y + 1, z: at.z }, 4.2); })()

steps.caption: El Átomo on patrol in Bajo la ciudad: its nucleus and three electrons, as the section draws it

steps.eval: (() => { const r = g.modelo.run; delete r.patrols['atomo-1']; if (!r.beaten.includes('atomo-1')) r.beaten.push('atomo-1'); })()

steps.caption: El fondo: the cage that brought them, and El que no converge half the gallery away
Its fight, staged in the gallery
